initialize_session.title: Open an MCP session
initialize_session.description: Begin an MCP session, telling the server which protocol version and capabilities the client supports and learning the server's in return. The protocol expects this before other calls, and the server's reply is what says whether it offers tools, prompts or resources at all.

protocol_version.description: MCP protocol version the client speaks, e.g. "2025-06-18".

capabilities.description: What the client supports, as the protocol's capabilities object.

client_name.description: Name the client identifies itself by.

client_version.description: Version the client identifies itself by.

output.description: The server's JSON-RPC response, carrying its protocol version and capabilities.

result.description: protocolVersion, capabilities and serverInfo.

list_server_tools.title: List the MCP server's tools
list_server_tools.description: Ask Asana's MCP server which tools it exposes, over the protocol's tools/list method. The server decides what it offers and publishes an inputSchema for each, so this is how to discover the real Asana surface -- and the exact argument names -- before calling anything.

cursor.description: Paging cursor from a previous tools/list response.

output.description: The server's JSON-RPC response listing its tools.

result.description: `tools`, each with a name, description and inputSchema.

call_server_tool.title: Call a tool on the MCP server
call_server_tool.description: Invoke one of the Asana MCP server's tools by name. The name and the shape of `arguments` come from `list_server_tools`, not from this package -- and since the server's tools act on the live workspace, one of them may create, update or delete tasks, projects and comments.

name.description: Name of the server tool to call, from list_server_tools.

arguments.description: Arguments for that tool, matching the inputSchema the server published.

result.description: `content` blocks, and `isError` when the tool itself failed.

list_server_prompts.title: List the MCP server's prompts
list_server_prompts.description: The prompt templates the server publishes, over the protocol's prompts/list method. A server that offers none answers with an empty list rather than an error.

cursor.description: Paging cursor from a previous prompts/list response.

output.description: The server's JSON-RPC response listing its prompts.

result.description: `prompts`, each with a name, description and arguments.

get_server_prompt.title: Get a prompt from the MCP server
get_server_prompt.description: Render one of the server's prompt templates with the arguments it declares, over prompts/get. Returns the messages the template expands to.

name.description: Name of the prompt, from list_server_prompts.

arguments.description: Values for the arguments that prompt declares.

result.description: `description` and the expanded `messages`.

list_server_resources.title: List the MCP server's resources
list_server_resources.description: The resources the server exposes for reading, over resources/list. Asana's server may offer none; it answers with an empty list rather than an error.

cursor.description: Paging cursor from a previous resources/list response.

output.description: The server's JSON-RPC response listing its resources.

result.description: `resources`, each with a uri, name and mimeType.

read_server_resource.title: Read a resource from the MCP server
read_server_resource.description: Fetch the contents of one resource by its URI, over resources/read. The URIs come from `list_server_resources`; the server decides how it addresses its own data.

uri.description: URI of the resource, from list_server_resources.

result.description: `contents`, each with a uri, mimeType and text or blob.

search_objects.title: Search Asana objects
search_objects.description: Search across tasks, projects, portfolios, goals, teams, users, tags, custom fields and AI Teammates by name. The first step when an object's GID is unknown; goals are only reachable this way (resource_type goal). Sends tools/call for search_objects.

arguments.description: Arguments for search_objects. Typically a query plus resource_type (task, project, portfolio, goal, team, user, tag, custom_field, agent or actor). The exact shape is the inputSchema list_server_tools returns for search_objects; Asana does not publish it in its docs.

result.description: `content` blocks, and `isError` when the tool itself failed.

get_task.title: Get a task
get_task.description: Read one task in full: name, description, assignee, dates, custom fields, projects, dependencies, subtasks and comments. Sends tools/call for get_task.

arguments.description: Arguments for get_task. Typically the task GID. The exact shape is the inputSchema list_server_tools returns for get_task; Asana does not publish it in its docs.

result.description: `content` blocks, and `isError` when the tool itself failed.

get_tasks.title: List tasks
get_tasks.description: List tasks by context -- a project, section, tag, user task list or assignee (at least one) -- optionally filtered by completion and modification date. Sends tools/call for get_tasks.

arguments.description: Arguments for get_tasks. One of project, section, tag, user task list or assignee, plus optional filters. The exact shape is the inputSchema list_server_tools returns for get_tasks; Asana does not publish it in its docs.

result.description: `content` blocks, and `isError` when the tool itself failed.

get_my_tasks.title: List my tasks
get_my_tasks.description: List the tasks assigned to the authenticated user, optionally only incomplete ones. Sends tools/call for get_my_tasks.

arguments.description: Arguments for get_my_tasks. Optional completion filter. The exact shape is the inputSchema list_server_tools returns for get_my_tasks; Asana does not publish it in its docs.

result.description: `content` blocks, and `isError` when the tool itself failed.

search_tasks.title: Search tasks
search_tasks.description: Full-text task search over names, descriptions and comments with filters for assignee, due and created dates, project, section, tag and custom fields. Premium workspaces only; use get_tasks elsewhere. Sends tools/call for search_tasks.

arguments.description: Arguments for search_tasks. A text query and filters. The exact shape is the inputSchema list_server_tools returns for search_tasks; Asana does not publish it in its docs.

result.description: `content` blocks, and `isError` when the tool itself failed.

get_project.title: Get a project
get_project.description: Read one project: name, description, owner, members, task counts and optionally its sections. Sends tools/call for get_project.

arguments.description: Arguments for get_project. The project GID; optionally whether to include sections. The exact shape is the inputSchema list_server_tools returns for get_project; Asana does not publish it in its docs.

result.description: `content` blocks, and `isError` when the tool itself failed.

get_projects.title: List projects
get_projects.description: List the workspace's projects, optionally for one team or including archived ones. Sends tools/call for get_projects.

arguments.description: Arguments for get_projects. Optional team and archived filters. The exact shape is the inputSchema list_server_tools returns for get_projects; Asana does not publish it in its docs.

result.description: `content` blocks, and `isError` when the tool itself failed.

get_portfolio.title: Get a portfolio
get_portfolio.description: Read one portfolio: name, owner and its projects. Sends tools/call for get_portfolio.

arguments.description: Arguments for get_portfolio. The portfolio GID. The exact shape is the inputSchema list_server_tools returns for get_portfolio; Asana does not publish it in its docs.

result.description: `content` blocks, and `isError` when the tool itself failed.

get_portfolios.title: List my portfolios
get_portfolios.description: List the portfolios the authenticated user owns in the workspace. Sends tools/call for get_portfolios.

arguments.description: Arguments for get_portfolios. Usually none. The exact shape is the inputSchema list_server_tools returns for get_portfolios; Asana does not publish it in its docs.

result.description: `content` blocks, and `isError` when the tool itself failed.

get_items_for_portfolio.title: List a portfolio's items
get_items_for_portfolio.description: List the projects and goals inside a portfolio, with names and GIDs. Sends tools/call for get_items_for_portfolio.

arguments.description: Arguments for get_items_for_portfolio. The portfolio GID. The exact shape is the inputSchema list_server_tools returns for get_items_for_portfolio; Asana does not publish it in its docs.

result.description: `content` blocks, and `isError` when the tool itself failed.

get_status_overview.title: Get a status overview
get_status_overview.description: Build an aggregated status report for projects or portfolios matching a keyword: details, current status updates, task summaries and flagged blockers. Does its own search -- do not search first. Sends tools/call for get_status_overview.

arguments.description: Arguments for get_status_overview. A keyword naming the initiative. The exact shape is the inputSchema list_server_tools returns for get_status_overview; Asana does not publish it in its docs.

result.description: `content` blocks, and `isError` when the tool itself failed.

get_attachments.title: List attachments
get_attachments.description: List the attachments on a task, project or project brief with file names, download urls and view urls. Sends tools/call for get_attachments.

arguments.description: Arguments for get_attachments. The parent object's GID. The exact shape is the inputSchema list_server_tools returns for get_attachments; Asana does not publish it in its docs.

result.description: `content` blocks, and `isError` when the tool itself failed.

get_user.title: Get a user
get_user.description: Read a user by GID, email or "me": name, email and workspace memberships. With no identifier, the authenticated user. Sends tools/call for get_user.

arguments.description: Arguments for get_user. A user GID, email or "me". The exact shape is the inputSchema list_server_tools returns for get_user; Asana does not publish it in its docs.

result.description: `content` blocks, and `isError` when the tool itself failed.

get_me.title: Get the authenticated user
get_me.description: Read the authenticated user's name, email and workspace memberships. Sends tools/call for get_me.

arguments.description: Arguments for get_me. None. The exact shape is the inputSchema list_server_tools returns for get_me; Asana does not publish it in its docs.

result.description: `content` blocks, and `isError` when the tool itself failed.

get_users.title: List users
get_users.description: List the workspace's users, optionally only members of one team. Paged. Sends tools/call for get_users.

arguments.description: Arguments for get_users. Optional team filter and paging. The exact shape is the inputSchema list_server_tools returns for get_users; Asana does not publish it in its docs.

result.description: `content` blocks, and `isError` when the tool itself failed.

get_teams.title: List teams
get_teams.description: List the workspace's teams, optionally only those one user belongs to. Sends tools/call for get_teams.

arguments.description: Arguments for get_teams. Optional user filter. The exact shape is the inputSchema list_server_tools returns for get_teams; Asana does not publish it in its docs.

result.description: `content` blocks, and `isError` when the tool itself failed.

get_agent.title: Get an AI Teammate
get_agent.description: Read one AI Teammate agent: name, description, behaviour guidance, workspace and photo. Sends tools/call for get_agent.

arguments.description: Arguments for get_agent. The agent GID, from get_workspace_agents. The exact shape is the inputSchema list_server_tools returns for get_agent; Asana does not publish it in its docs.

result.description: `content` blocks, and `isError` when the tool itself failed.

get_workspace_agents.title: List AI Teammates
get_workspace_agents.description: List the AI Teammate agents configured in the workspace (not human users). Paged. Sends tools/call for get_workspace_agents.

arguments.description: Arguments for get_workspace_agents. Optional paging. The exact shape is the inputSchema list_server_tools returns for get_workspace_agents; Asana does not publish it in its docs.

result.description: `content` blocks, and `isError` when the tool itself failed.

create_tasks.title: Create tasks
create_tasks.description: Create up to 50 tasks at once, with no confirmation step: project, section, parent (for subtasks), assignee, dates, description, followers and custom fields per task. Sends tools/call for create_tasks.

arguments.description: Arguments for create_tasks. A list of tasks. The exact shape is the inputSchema list_server_tools returns for create_tasks; Asana does not publish it in its docs.

result.description: `content` blocks, and `isError` when the tool itself failed.

create_project.title: Create a project
create_project.description: Create a project immediately, optionally with its sections and tasks in the same call. Sends tools/call for create_project.

arguments.description: Arguments for create_project. Name, team and optional sections and tasks. The exact shape is the inputSchema list_server_tools returns for create_project; Asana does not publish it in its docs.

result.description: `content` blocks, and `isError` when the tool itself failed.

update_tasks.title: Update tasks
update_tasks.description: Update up to 50 tasks at once: name, assignee, dates, description, completion, parent, dependencies, project membership, followers and custom fields. Sends tools/call for update_tasks.

arguments.description: Arguments for update_tasks. A list of task GIDs with the fields to change. The exact shape is the inputSchema list_server_tools returns for update_tasks; Asana does not publish it in its docs.

result.description: `content` blocks, and `isError` when the tool itself failed.

delete_task.title: Delete a task
delete_task.description: Permanently delete a task and those of its subtasks not in another project. Cannot be undone. Sends tools/call for delete_task.

arguments.description: Arguments for delete_task. The task GID. The exact shape is the inputSchema list_server_tools returns for delete_task; Asana does not publish it in its docs.

result.description: `content` blocks, and `isError` when the tool itself failed.

add_comment.title: Comment on a task
add_comment.description: Add a plain-text or HTML comment to a task, with @-mentions by GID and optional pinning. For discussion only, not for changes Asana logs itself. Sends tools/call for add_comment.

arguments.description: Arguments for add_comment. The task GID and the comment text. The exact shape is the inputSchema list_server_tools returns for add_comment; Asana does not publish it in its docs.

result.description: `content` blocks, and `isError` when the tool itself failed.

create_project_status_update.title: Post a status update
create_project_status_update.description: Post a status update on a project or portfolio with a title, a colour (green, yellow, red, blue or complete) and body text. Sends tools/call for create_project_status_update.

arguments.description: Arguments for create_project_status_update. The parent GID, title, status colour and text. The exact shape is the inputSchema list_server_tools returns for create_project_status_update; Asana does not publish it in its docs.

result.description: `content` blocks, and `isError` when the tool itself failed.

create_task_preview.title: Draft a task for review
create_task_preview.description: Draft one task and present it for confirmation before it is created. Renders an interactive UI in Claude and ChatGPT only; other clients should use create_tasks. Sends tools/call for create_task_preview.

arguments.description: Arguments for create_task_preview. Name, assignee, dates, project and section. The exact shape is the inputSchema list_server_tools returns for create_task_preview; Asana does not publish it in its docs.

result.description: `content` blocks, and `isError` when the tool itself failed.

create_project_preview.title: Draft a project for review
create_project_preview.description: Draft a project plan -- sections, tasks, assignees, dates, priorities -- for confirmation before it is created. Interactive UI in Claude and ChatGPT only. Sends tools/call for create_project_preview.

arguments.description: Arguments for create_project_preview. A description of the project to plan. The exact shape is the inputSchema list_server_tools returns for create_project_preview; Asana does not publish it in its docs.

result.description: `content` blocks, and `isError` when the tool itself failed.

search_tasks_preview.title: Search tasks in an interactive view
search_tasks_preview.description: Search tasks and show them in an interactive UI (Claude and ChatGPT), filtered by assignee, due and start dates, completion and text. Sends tools/call for search_tasks_preview.

arguments.description: Arguments for search_tasks_preview. Filters and a text query. The exact shape is the inputSchema list_server_tools returns for search_tasks_preview; Asana does not publish it in its docs.

result.description: `content` blocks, and `isError` when the tool itself failed.
